nui_xa.use: Phông núi xa sau bản đồ (thay các khối nón xa)
nui_xa.subject: A wide panorama of distant immortal mountains in the style of the Song-dynasty blue-green landscape 'A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains': three or four layered ranges of steep, tall peaks, nearest range darkest ink with jade-green and stone-blue washes on the slopes, farther ranges paler and paler until they are only faint grey silhouettes. A few tiny pavilions and a thin waterfall on the peaks, bands of white mist drifting between the ranges. Composition: peaks occupy the upper 70% of the image; the lowest 30% dissolves completely into pure white mist so it blends into the map below.

vach_da.use: Vách đá trên ô Đá (rìa sau bản đồ), 2×2 ô
vach_da.subject: A rugged rocky outcrop / small cliff for the edge of a mountain sect: several stacked angular boulders with cracked faces, dry-brush texture strokes (cun fa) on the rock, a twisted small pine clinging to one side, some moss in muted jade green at the base. Its footprint fills the 2×2 diamond and it rises to about the height of the dashed box.
variants: tall stacked cliff of angular boulders with a clinging pine
wide low rocky ledge with moss
cliff with a thin trickle of waterfall down one face
pile of three big boulders with ferns
jagged rock spire with cracked faces
cliff with a small dark cave opening
mossy rounded boulders with a shrub

vach_da.sheetSubject: Rocky outcrops for the edge of a mountain sect: angular stacked boulders with cracked faces, dry-brush texture strokes (cun fa), moss in muted jade green. Each one covers its cell's 2×2 diamond footprint.

tung.use: Cây tùng trang trí trên ô cỏ trống, 1×1 ô
tung.subject: A single ancient pine tree (cổ tùng): gnarled, twisting trunk with flaking bark drawn in dry brush, layered flat clusters of needles in dark ink with muted jade-green wash, slightly leaning, elegant scholar-painting silhouette. Trunk base sits in the center of the diamond; the crown reaches about the top of the dashed box.
variants: ancient pine leaning strongly to the left, long horizontal top branch
tall upright pine with a split twin trunk and layered crown
windswept pine bent to the right, crown swept sideways

tung.sheetSubject: Ancient pine trees (cổ tùng): gnarled trunks with flaking bark in dry brush, layered flat needle clusters in dark ink with muted jade-green wash, elegant scholar-painting silhouettes. Each trunk base sits on the center of its cell's diamond.

duong_da.subject: Old flagstone path: irregular rectangular paving stones in light-to-mid grey ink wash with thin dark ink joints, a little moss in the joints, worn edges. Fill the whole square edge to edge.

mat_nuoc.subject: Calm stream water as an ink painter would draw it: pale grey-blue (#B7C3BE) wash with rhythmic thin ink ripple lines (curved wave strokes in the Song painting manner), mostly empty paper-like surface between the lines. Fill the whole square edge to edge.

dat_co.subject: Bare ground of a mountain meadow, very subtle: warm paper beige (#EFE6D2) with faint uneven ink washes and a few tiny grass strokes and dots in muted green and grey. Low contrast — it must stay quiet behind buildings. Fill the whole square edge to edge.

truc.subject: A small clump of five or six bamboo stalks with jointed stems in ink and slender leaves drawn as quick 'ge' character strokes, leaves in dark ink with muted jade-green wash, gently leaning as if in a breeze. Rooted in the center of the diamond, reaching about the top of the dashed box.
variants: dense clump of seven tall bamboo stalks, full foliage

truc.sheetSubject: Bamboo (trúc): jointed stalks in ink, slender leaves drawn as quick brush strokes, dark ink with muted jade-green wash. Each clump is rooted on the center of its cell's diamond.

dao.use: Cây đào hoa trang trí (xuân), 1×1 ô
dao.subject: A small peach blossom tree: dark angular ink branches, clusters of pale pink blossoms dotted in light wash (the only pink in the image, kept soft and muted), a few petals falling. Rooted in the center of the diamond, crown reaching about the top of the dashed box.

dao.sheetSubject: Peach blossom trees (đào): dark angular ink branches, clusters of pale pink blossoms in light wash, kept soft and muted. Each trunk base sits on the center of its cell's diamond.

lau_say.use: Cụm lau sậy ven nước, 1×1 ô
